notes.title: Offenders Update 1.1
notes.notes:
offenders update 1.1
1) each mission got a new waypoint to show the destination so no need for the player to discover the whole level to find his destination.
2) cover animation fixed.
3) graphics in mission 1 has been edited.
4) some bugs in the next missions have been fixed.
5) crosshair of the weapons has been edited.
6) dealing with people by money or without money is turned to dealing by money only to reduce the complexity of dealing with people.

notes.title: offenders update 1.0
notes.notes:
1) glitches of AI players have been fixed.
2) cover system has been improved.
3) combat mode with enemies has been improved.
